name: Frasers House Singapore, a Luxury Collection Hotel
positioning: Heritage-inspired luxury hotel in Singapore's Bugis district, conceived around the area's history of artisans, with a Main Tower and a shophouse-style Heritage Wing
best_for: Travelers who want a central Bugis base near Kampong Glam
Families wanting a suite with a kids' play area

facts.text: The hotel is in Singapore's Bugis district, steps from the Bugis MRT station.
Bugis once thrived as a quarter of artisans, tailors, goldsmiths, woodcarvers and perfumers.
Guests can choose between light-filled rooms in the Main Tower or the Heritage Wing, inspired by traditional Singapore shophouse living.
The Classic Room features bespoke furnishings, a bathtub and a separate walk-in shower.
The Presidential Suite has a dining room that seats up to 12 guests and an ensuite bathroom with a private sauna.
Guests can unwind by the outdoor swimming pool and use a spacious fitness center with tailored wellness programs.
The Executive Lounge has warm timber floors, louvered windows and curated furnishings.
Each afternoon, guests can taste signature cookies reinterpreting laksa, chicken rice and ondeh ondeh, paired with TehKita.
The Maker's Serambi is a bi-monthly showcase of handcrafted works by artisans, makers and creators.
Dining spans Cantonese cuisine at Man Fu Yuan and Italian cuisine at LUCE.
Chikuyotei, the hotel's Japanese restaurant, specializes in unagi, omakase and a la carte.

highlights.text: Each space in the hotel reinterprets a trade once found in Bugis, such as the glassblower's bar, the perfumer's lounge and the silversmith's salon.
Heritage Wing rooms and suites draw on Singapore's historic shophouses and Peranakan heritage, with timber flooring and ornate furnishings.
The Curated Sensory Journey, guided by the Concierge team, explores Kampong Glam through sight, taste, sound, scent and touch, and is complimentary for in-house guests.
The Family Suite has a dedicated kids' themed area with bunk beds, a slide and a play zone.

considerations.text: Parking for hotel guests is at Bugis Junction Carpark.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflecting the luxury positioning.
